title: New Books, New Decisions: Gujarati New Year & Padwa
hook: Today marks a fresh ledger. Most marketing teams still carry over the exact same blind spots.
festival: Govardhan Puja / Diwali Padwa / Gujarati New Year 2026
caption:
Today marks a fresh ledger.

Traditional accounts close for Chopda Pujan, and new books open with Saal Mubarak.

Yet on Monday morning, most performance teams will log right back into the same twenty dashboards and make guesses from the exact same charts.

Plenty of data. Still no memory.

A new year shouldn't mean logging more numbers. It should mean knowing why your winners won, cutting what didn't work, and moving from dashboards to decisions.

Every ad should make the next one better.

Nutan Varshabhinandan and a very happy Diwali Padwa from all of us at Galvor.
